messages:
devon: heads-up: ap-southeast1 provisioning spike — ~140 pending GPU allocations. canary nodes flipped UEFI lockdown bit after BMC microcode 2.3.1-hotfix, PXE netboot failing on ~22 nodes. investigating.
ops-bot: alert: fleet.provisioner.ap-southeast1 error_rate=12% > threshold (auto-escalate)
maya: autoscaler is backing off, queue piling. can we divert new jobs to dedicated reserved pool while we triage?
alex.sre: grabbing logs now. sample: `bmcctl get-attr --node rack-42-10` -> "uefi_lockdown: enabled", boot_status: PXE_TIMEOUT
jackie_infra: is that the rollout from last night? who owns fw-roll-2026-03-20-42?
devon: that rollout is mine. pausing it now. paused job fw-roll-2026-03-20-42 at 1745679930. starting rollback on canary group.
maya: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/provisioning-uefi (updated 03/12) follow step 3 for rollback + NV reset.
alex.sre: console logs show TFTP 404 for pxelinux.cfg, but BMC is returning wrong MAC->filename mapping. looks like inventory tag mismatch after microcode write.
devon: quick mitigation: routing policy to route new long-running allocations to eu-central fallback and enable prewarm on dedicated to absorb spikes. doing that now.
paul_support: heads-up to CS: three enterprise tenants hit throttles/queue timeouts. I'm drafting a short blurb for status page.
jackie_infra: initiating cold reboot + microcode rollback on affected 22 nodes. ETA ~15-20m per rack, running in parallel in 3 racks. posting updates.
ops-bot: deploy job fw-roll-2026-03-20-42 paused by devon at 1745679930
maya: quick cost note: warm failovers to eu-central and prewarm reserved capacity adds ~18% hourly infra run cost. rough delta ~$2.3k/day if sustained. logging in INFRA-COST.
devon: rollback finished for canary group A (22 nodes) -> netboot success on 18/22. 4 nodes show nvram mismatch, attempting forced nvram reset.
alex.sre: nvram reset cmd in runbook: `ipmitool -H $BMC -U admin -P <masked> raw 0x30 0x70 0x0c 0x01 0x00` — use with care. added note to runbook.
paul_support: CX notified; status page update scheduled after 1745680300.
maya: next actions: 1) fleet audit for microcode 2.3.1 installs 2) tighten canary to 5 nodes 3) add preflight check verifying uefi_lockdown bit before commit.
devon: creating ticket INFRA-2026-141 with rollback artifacts + cost delta, cc @jackie_infra @alex.sre.
jackie_infra: will run postmortem if failure rate >1% after 24h. closing loop for now, thanks all :thumbsup:
